content.short: Arbitrum Orbit provides rollup-as-a-service (RaaS) infrastructure to create self-managed Arbitrum Rollup and AnyTrust chains.
content.description: Arbitrum Orbit enables you to create and operate your own self-managed Arbitrum Rollup and AnyTrust chains. By leveraging Rollup and AnyTrust technology, Orbit offers maximum flexibility for configuring your bespoke Orbit chain. It provides fully functional fraud proofs, advanced compression, and strong EVM compatibility to support a wide range of decentralized applications and tooling built on the Arbitrum ecosystem. This setup supports scalable deployment and makes it straightforward to integrate with existing tooling across Ethereum-compatible networks.
content.meta: Arbitrum Orbit is a rollup infrastructure solution. Discover Arbitrum Orbit and other RaaS Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
